description: This file defines the PaypalPayment class, a subclass of Payment, representing a PayPal transaction within the payment processing model. It includes attributes for payer ID and payment token, and initializes the payment type to PayPal.

classes.name: PaypalPayment
classes.description: Represents a PayPal payment, extending the Payment class, including payer ID and payment token attributes.

methods.name: PaypalPayment
methods.description: Constructor that sets the payment type to PayPal.

methods.name: setPayerId
methods.description: Sets the payer ID associated with the PayPal payment.

methods.name: setPaymentToken
methods.description: Sets the payment token issued by PayPal.
